outstandingFindings.summary: The allowed_total counter carried no user_id label, so only DENIED principals were attributable. A granted principal exercising a route group was indistinguishable from one that never called it, which left ratified coverage criterion 1(b) satisfiable only by per-cell operator attestation.
outstandingFindings.resolvedEvidence: Root cause was a CODE gap, not a production-window gap, and the finding itself prescribed the fix. internal/metrics/auth.go now labels AuthCorpusGrantAllowed {route_group, user_id, session_source} and RecordCorpusGrantAllowed takes userID; internal/api/corpus_grant_gate.go passes sess.UserID at the call site, AFTER auth.GateGlobalCorpusRead has already decided, so the counter cannot influence the outcome. Held by TestCorpusGrantMetrics_BothCountersCarryUserIDSoCoverageIsComputable and TestCorpusGrantMetrics_CoverageCellIsClosableByEitherOutcome. docs/Operations.md and design.md 4 now carry the union query that closes a coverage cell from EITHER outcome.
